#Calculate grooming network metrics in the groups were males immigrated from the year postimmigration

This scrip generates two files:
1. csv called network_mets_groom_bayes.csv with the networ metrics 
2. rds file called groom_posteriors.rds with the posterior draws that we will use for the models
```{r}
source("/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/Pooja_chapter_matrank/Analyses/bayes_nets_sem/bison_groom_net_script.R")
```
132 males with posteriors

Variable explanation:
Here's how each output column is calculated:
Identification:

Code — the immigrant male's ID
group — the group he immigrated into
start_date — immigration date
end_date — immigration date + 365 days

Bayesian in-strength (how much others groom this male):

For each directed dyad X→male, we sample edge weights from Beta(0.1 + days_X_groomed_male, 0.1 + observation_days - days_X_groomed_male)
In-strength = sum of all incoming edge weights for the focal male in each posterior draw
in_strength_mean / _lower / _upper — mean and 95% credible interval across 1000 draws

Bayesian out-strength (how much this male grooms others):

Same as above but for dyads male→X
Out-strength = sum of all outgoing edge weights
out_strength_mean / _lower / _upper

Bayesian in-degree (number of individuals who groom this male):

Count of non-zero incoming edges per posterior draw
in_degree_mean / _lower / _upper

Bayesian out-degree (number of individuals this male grooms):

Count of non-zero outgoing edges per posterior draw
out_degree_mean / _lower / _upper

Bayesian eigenvector centrality:

For each draw, the directed network is collapsed to undirected (summing edge weights in both directions) and eigenvector centrality is computed via igraph::eigen_centrality()
Captures how well-connected the male's grooming partners are
eigenvector_mean / _lower / _upper

Classic grooming rate (non-Bayesian):

grooming_rate = number of distinct days the male was involved in ANY grooming (giving or receiving) / total observation days in that group and window. A simple point estimate with no uncertainty.

Sampling info:

days_observed — number of distinct days with ad-lib affiliative data in that group during the 365-day window (the denominator for all rates)
median_group_size — median daily group size from the presence matrix during the window
n_dyads — total number of directed grooming dyads in the network (not just the focal male's)
